Description: Another day, another wall to stare at... I swear these stones are multiplying.
The fire crackles, but it feels like it’s mocking me more than warming me.
I counted the crates again today… still the same number as yesterday. Thrilling life, isn’t it?
Upstairs, the guards act important, but down here we’re the ones keeping the dust company.
Sometimes I wonder if this place is guarding us, or if we’re guarding it.
If you listen closely, you can hear the walls sing. Or maybe that’s just me… singing.
